members.reason: ["Missing: any source showing what ended this order's status-quo command. The registered NMB item for Emergency Board No. 104 (2-page listing sheet) is not a board report: it states that no members were appointed and that the parties reached agreement on April 26, 1953, so no board was constituted and no report was made. The order's no-change sentence runs until thirty days after a report that was never made, so its own terms give no end date, and no held source states the legal effect of the agreement on that sentence. EO 12553 (1986-02-25) is only the formal disposition."]
